mapper.sql: CAST(id AS CHAR) id,CAST(sku_id AS CHAR) skuId,quantity,selected
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cart_item WHERE customer_id=CAST(#{owner} AS UNSIGNED) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cart_item WHERE customer_id=CAST(#{owner} AS UNSIGNED)
SELECT FROM cart_item WHERE customer_id=CAST(#{owner} AS UNSIGNED) AND id=CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED)
SELECT FROM cart_item WHERE customer_id=CAST(#{owner} AS UNSIGNED) AND sku_id=CAST(#{skuId} AS UNSIGNED)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item(customer_id,sku_id,quantity,selected) VALUES(CAST(#{owner} AS UNSIGNED),CAST(#{skuId} AS UNSIGNED),#{quantity},TRUE)
mapper.update: UPDATE cart_item SET quantity=#{quantity},selected=#{selected},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE customer_id=CAST(#{owner} AS UNSIGNED) AND id=CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_item WHERE customer_id=CAST(#{owner} AS UNSIGNED) AND id=CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED)
